blocks.label: DAY 9
blocks.ko: 아홉째 날

blocks.html: The water under the hill has been warm for thirty years. Before light on the ninth day, so is the stone in Yushin’s sleeve.
blocks.ko: 언덕 아래 물은 서른 해 동안 따뜻했다. 아홉째 날 동트기 전, 유신의 소매 속 돌도 따뜻하다.

blocks.label: The Lake, Again
blocks.ko: 다시 호수로

blocks.html: So Yushin goes to the cavern lake, as if habit could hold a country together.
blocks.ko: 그래서 유신은 습관이 나라를 붙잡아 주기라도 할 것처럼 동굴 호수로 간다.

blocks.html: Yushin undresses without ceremony. The three are already in the steam — mentors, tormentors, the only room in Silla where no one asks him for a victory.
blocks.ko: 유신은 격식 없이 옷을 벗는다. 셋은 이미 김 속에 있다 — 스승이자 장난꾼, 신라에서 승리를 요구하지 않는 유일한 방.
blocks.art: Golhwa on the rock, legs open; Hyullé, knees pressed, eyes down, silk soaked.

blocks.html: Golhwa knows that walk and is already wet for it. She watches him like a problem she means to solve with her body.
blocks.ko: 골화는 그 걸음을 알고, 이미 젖어 있다. 몸으로 풀 문제를 보듯 그를 본다.

en: You came early. How flattering.
He came because he is about to kill a friend.
Forest etiquette: say it plain.

lines: 그걸 알면, 안 하는 법을 가르치시오.
en: If you know that, tell me how not to.

lines: 머리띠를 기억할 상처는 남기고. 칼에 고마워하길 바라는 상처는 버리세요.
en: You can’t.
…I’m sorry.
Keep the wound that remembers the headband. Lose the one that wants him to thank you for the blade.

lines: 아니면 또 여왕께 감사 인사를 아껴 두는 거겠지.
물 속에는 여왕이 없어, 유신. 우리가 있어.
en: Unless you’re saving all your thank-yous for the Queen again.
She is not in the water, Yushin. We are.

blocks.html: She takes his wrist under the water and does not wait for the Queen’s name to finish. For a few breaths there is only steam, and the walk they already know, and a marshal who cannot keep his arithmetic. Then Narim’s voice cuts the wick.
blocks.ko: 물 속에서 손목을 잡고, 여왕의 이름이 끝나기를 기다리지 않는다. 몇 숨은 김뿐이고, 이미 아는 걸음뿐이고, 셈을 지키지 못하는 장군뿐이다. 그러다 나림의 목소리가 심지를 자른다.

en: But Her Majesty —

lines: 그는 갈 거다. 갑옷을 벗고도 그 이름을 붙들고 있을 때부터 알았다.
en: Enough, fire.
He will go. We knew that when he took the armour off and still kept her name on.
…Go.
Give Sunduk the victory.
Keep a little silence for us.

lines: 질문은 하나다, 김. 물에서. 한 번만.
en: So the stone woke you.
One question, Kim. From the water. Once.

blocks.html: Steam thins. Two shapes wait where the rock shelves into black: the father who taught him that loyalty is soil, and the grandfather who traded a kingdom so a grandson could keep a sword.
blocks.ko: 김이 옅어진다. 바위가 검은 물로 꺾이는 곳에 형상 둘이 기다린다 — 충성이야말로 흙이라고 가르친 아버지, 그리고 손자가 칼을 지키도록 나라를 넘겨 준 할아버지.

lines: 여드레 사이에 같은 입이 저를 신국의 구원자라 부르고, 가야 놈이라 불렀습니다.
열흘째 아침에는 그중 어느 쪽을 들고 나가야 합니까.
en: Father. Grandfather.
In eight days the same mouth has called me the sacred country’s saviour and a Gaya wretch.
Which of the two do I carry out to the tenth morning?

lines: 너는 내 인생의 빛이었고, 이제 나라는 네가 구원자가 되기를 필요로 한다.
미안하다… 내가 신라의 피가 아니어서. 가야의 뿌리를 잊으려 애썼고, 내가 아닌 무언가인 척하려 했다.
하지만 너는 더 이상 그렇게 할 필요가 없다.
아들아, 너는 강력한 신라의 도검이며, 가야의 마지막 왕자이기도 하다.
그러나 너는 그보다 무한히 더 크다…!
네 어머니와 나는 네가 더없이 자랑스럽다…!
en: Yushin, my beloved son.
You were the light of my life, and now the nation needs you to be its savior.
I am sorry that I was not of Silla blood… I tried my hardest to forget my Gaya roots, and tried to pretend that I was something I was not.
But you don’t need to do that anymore.
Son, you are the mighty Sword of Silla, and the Last Prince of Gaya.
But you are infinitely more than that…!
You are my son. You are Kim Yushin.
Your mother and I couldn’t be more proud of you…!

lines: 내가 신라 왕실에 충성을 맹세했을 때, 그것은 나 자신을 위해서가 아니라 — 너를 위해서였다.
나는 너를 알기 전에 너를 사랑했다.
en: Yushin, my beloved grandson.
When I swore allegiance to the Silla crown, it was not for my own sake, but for yours.
I loved you before I knew you.
Yushin, look at me.
I am so, so proud of you…!
Father…
Grandfather…
Thank you.
blocks.art: Yushin crying.

en: Look at him — he’s crying.
blocks.art: Golhwa holding back tears.

blocks.html: He comes up out of the water with the stone gone cold again in his fist. He does not need it warm any more.
blocks.ko: 그는 다시 식어 버린 돌을 주먹에 쥐고 물에서 올라온다. 이제 따뜻할 필요가 없다.

blocks.label: The Outer Works
blocks.ko: 외성

blocks.html: By midday the ninth day has turned into the battle both sides spent eight days pretending they could avoid. The palace blue goes up the road all the way to the outer works under the Radiance wall, and the black comes down off the rampart to throw it back.
blocks.ko: 한낮이 되자 아홉째 날은, 양쪽이 여드레 동안 피할 수 있는 척했던 싸움이 된다. 궁의 푸른 띠가 길을 따라 명활성 아래 외성까지 밀고 올라가고, 검은 띠가 성벽에서 쏟아져 내려와 그것을 밀어낸다.

blocks.html: Yumjong goes down in the outer ditch with a Silla spear under his arm. Bidam reaches him before the rebels finish falling back.
blocks.ko: 염종은 신라 창을 겨드랑이에 꽂은 채 바깥 도랑에서 쓰러진다. 반군이 다 물러서기도 전에 비담이 그에게 닿는다.

lines: 행군했잖습니까. 안 할 거라 하셨는데. 했잖습니까…
……그래도 좋은 말이었지요. 가야. 다들 외치기 좋아했는데.
en: Don’t— don’t make that face, Councillor.
They marched. You said they wouldn’t. They marched…
…It was a good word, though. Gaya. They liked shouting it.
Yumjong.
…Yumjong.

blocks.html: The quieter name on the banner goes first. Bidam closes his eyes for him and does not let anyone see his hand.
blocks.ko: 깃발의 더 조용한 이름이 먼저 간다. 비담은 손수 그의 눈을 감겨 주고, 그 손을 아무에게도 보이지 않는다.

blocks.html: By dusk the granary inside the Moon Palace is down to its last sacks, and men who have never prayed are learning the postures. Alchun is asked, for the last useful time, which wall he belongs to.
blocks.ko: 해 질 무렵 월성 안 곳간은 마지막 섬만 남고, 기도해 본 적 없는 사내들이 무릎 꿇는 자세를 배운다. 알천은 마지막으로 쓸모 있는 질문을 받는다. 어느 성벽에 속하느냐고.

lines: 나는 이 주를 살아남는 나라에 속한다.
그 답이 공허하다면 — 너희가 나중에 내게 줄 자리도 공허할 것이다.
en: I belong to the country that survives the week.
If that answer is empty — then so is the chair you will offer me afterward.

blocks.html: He still does not draw. Surabol will remember that sentence for years: the man who caught tigers, filed under Neither.
blocks.ko: 그는 끝내 칼을 뽑지 않는다. 서라벌은 그 문장을 오래 기억할 것이다. 호랑이를 잡던 남자, ‘어느 쪽도 아님’으로 분류되어.

blocks.label: The Rampart
blocks.ko: 성벽 위

blocks.html: That night, on Radiance’s rampart, Bidam speaks — to his officers, to the wall, to whichever chronicler is still awake. They expect a battle plan. They get a confession.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤, 명활성 성벽 위에서 비담이 말한다 — 장교들에게, 성벽에게, 아직 깨어 있는 사관에게. 그들은 작전을 기대한다. 돌아오는 것은 고백이다.

lines: 알겠느냐… 우리는 이 나라를 “신국”이라 부른다. 하지만 우리나라는 세상에서 가장 위대한 나라가 아니다.
그 왕들이 가장 지혜로운 것도 아니다. 그 군대가 가장 강한 것도 아니다.
그 남자들이 가장 고결한 것도, 그 여자들이 가장 정숙한 것도 아니다.
우리 산천은 아름답지만, 더 아름다운 경치는 다른 곳에 있다.
우리나라가 가진 좋은 것 하나마다, 더 큰 것을 가진 나라들이 있다.
en: You know… we call this country the “sacred country.” But our country isn’t the greatest in the world.
Its kings are not the most wise. Its armies are not the strongest.
Its men are not the most noble. Its women are not the most chaste.
Our natural scenery is beautiful, but there are more beautiful sights elsewhere.
For every good thing our nation has, there are other nations with greater things.

lines: 하지만 — 그래서 신국이라 부르는 것이 아니다.
en: However — that is not why we call it the sacred country.

lines: 우리가 신국이라 부르는 것은, 이 나라가 우리의 것이기 때문이다.
우리의 왕이 우리의 백성을 다스리기 때문이다. 우리의 군대가 우리의 아들들로 이루어져 있기 때문이다.
우리의 남자들이 매일 일어나, 내일을 오늘보다 낫게 만들려 하기 때문이다.
우리의 여자들이 매일 밤, 우리의 피와 씨로 다음 세대를 길러 냈음을 알고 잠들기 때문이다.
우리의 산과 강이, 우리가 어려서 함께 자란 곳이기 때문이다 — 아버지와 놀던 곳, 그리고 우리의 아들과 놀 곳.
en: We call it the sacred country, because it is ours.
Because our kings rule over our people. Because our armies are composed of our sons.
Because our men get up every day, and try to make the next day better.
Because our women go to sleep every night, knowing that they have raised our next generation with our blood and our seed.
Because our hills and rivers are the ones that we have grown up with as children — where we used to play with our fathers, and where we will play with our sons.
That is what I am defending.

lines: 왕실은 나를 반역자라, 이단자라, 시대에 맞춰야 할 늙은이라 부르겠지…
…그 모든 것에 나는 그저 아니라고 말한다.
en: The crown may call me a traitor, a heretic, an old man who needs to adapt to the times…
…and to all of that, I simply say no.
I don’t need to say any more than that.

lines: 그리고 언젠가, 우리의 후손들이 내가 옳았음을 증명할 것이다.
그러니 오라, 운명이여! 비담은 우리의 것을 지킬 준비가 되었다.
en: And one day, our descendants will prove me right.
So come at me, fate! Bidam is ready to defend what is ours.

blocks.label: DAY 10
blocks.ko: 열째 날

blocks.html: Before the gate opens Bidam goes down to the lines and saddles Bisamun himself, which a High Councillor does not do. He slips nine beads off the end of his string and knots them to the bridle, under the horse’s jaw.
blocks.ko: 성문이 열리기 전 비담은 진영으로 내려가 비사문에 손수 안장을 얹는다. 상대등이 할 일은 아니다. 염주 끝에서 아홉 알을 빼내, 말 턱 아래 굴레에 매듭지어 묶는다.

en: Sangdaedeung, those are…

lines: 부리는 짐승은 죽이지 마라. 말, 소, 닭, 개.
……저쪽은 그저께 흰 말을 태웠지. 내가 지더라도 이 녀석은 누가 붙잡고 있어야 해.
en: Master Wongwang’s fifth precept. Be choosy about killing.
Never the animals that work for you. Horse, ox, chicken, dog.
…They burned a white horse over there two nights ago. Even if I lose, somebody should still be holding on to this one.

blocks.html: Bisamun is named for the guardian king who stands at the north of every temple with a pagoda in his hand. Bidam rubs the horse’s nose once and speaks to it in the voice he keeps for sutras.
blocks.ko: 비사문은 탑을 손에 들고 모든 절의 북쪽에 서 있는 천왕에게서 따온 이름이다. 비담은 말의 코를 한 번 쓰다듬고, 경을 욀 때의 목소리로 말한다.

en: You’re named for the one who guards the north.
Today just watch the west.

blocks.html: All conditioned things are like a dream, an illusion, a bubble, a shadow; like dew, and like lightning. So should you see them.
blocks.ko: 모든 유위법은 꿈과 같고 환상과 같고 물거품과 같고 그림자와 같으며, 이슬과 같고 번개와 같으니, 마땅히 이와 같이 볼지니라.
blocks.hanja: 一切有為法，如夢、幻、泡、影，如露亦如電，應作如是觀。
blocks.source: Diamond Sutra (金剛般若波羅蜜經) §32, tr. Kumārajīva · T08n0235, p. 752b · Sanskrit: Vajracchedikā §32 (Conze ed.)
blocks.native: तारका तिमिरं दीपो मायावश्याय बुद्बुदम् । सुपिनं विद्युदभ्रं च एवं द्रष्टव्यं संस्कृतम् ॥
blocks.nativeLatn: tārakā timiraṃ dīpo māyāvaśyāya budbudam | supinaṃ vidyud abhraṃ ca evaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ saṃskṛtam ||

blocks.label: Between the Camps
blocks.ko: 두 진영 사이

blocks.html: On the tenth morning the grain is gone, and the palace gate opens from the inside, exactly as Bidam said it would. Out of it comes the Marshal of Silla at a gallop, on a grey horse that had no name the day before yesterday.
blocks.ko: 열째 날 아침, 곳간은 비었고, 궁문이 안에서 열린다. 비담이 말한 그대로다. 그 문에서 나오는 것은 신라의 대장군이다. 그저께까지 이름도 없던 회색 말을 타고, 질풍처럼.

blocks.html: Bidam rides out to meet him and stops halfway. He gets down, slaps Bisamun on the rump and sends him back to the lines. A spear’s length off, Yushin gets down too. They learned this on foot.
blocks.ko: 비담이 마주 나가다 중간에서 멈춘다. 말에서 내려 비사문의 엉덩이를 쳐 진영으로 돌려보낸다. 창 한 자루 거리에서 유신도 내린다. 둘은 이것을 땅에서 배웠다.

blocks.html: They meet again between the camps — not as High Councillor and marshal, but as the yard’s two best. Dragon pommel against heavenly horse. The first exchanges are almost gentle. That is how Hwarang kill each other.
blocks.ko: 다시 진영 사이에서 만난다 — 상대등과 대장군이 아니라, 연무장의 두 최고로. 용 자루 머리와 천마. 처음 몇 수는 거의 다정하다. 화랑은 그렇게 서로를 죽인다.

blocks.html: The yard drill first. High guard, cut, step, return. Bidam is fifty-three and moves like it, until he doesn’t.
blocks.ko: 먼저 연무장 연습 그대로다. 높은 자세, 베기, 한 걸음, 제자리. 비담은 쉰셋이고 쉰셋처럼 움직인다. 그러지 않을 때까지는.

en: You still drop your left shoulder.
You still talk.

blocks.html: Bidam’s third cut is a feint and the fourth isn’t. It opens a line above Yushin’s brow, right where a Hwarang headband sits. Yushin’s hand goes to his forehead, the way a new boy’s does in the hall when the seniors start in on him.
blocks.ko: 비담의 셋째 칼은 허초이고, 넷째는 아니다. 그 칼이 유신의 이마 위, 화랑 머리띠가 앉는 바로 그 자리에 금을 긋는다. 유신의 손이 이마로 간다. 강당에서 선배들이 시비를 걸 때 새로 온 아이의 손이 그러듯.

blocks.html: Yushin steps inside the next cut, too close for either blade. Bidam’s bead string catches on the dragon ring of his hilt. For one breath they are tied together at the wrist.
blocks.ko: 유신이 다음 칼 안쪽으로, 어느 칼도 쓸 수 없을 만큼 가까이 파고든다. 비담의 염주 줄이 유신 칼자루의 용 고리에 걸린다. 한 숨 동안 둘은 손목으로 묶여 있다.

en: …Let go, Gaya.
You let go.

blocks.html: Neither does. The string does instead.
blocks.ko: 둘 다 놓지 않는다. 대신 줄이 놓는다.

blocks.html: Yushin wins the way a man wins when he would rather lose — late, ugly, through a guard he taught Bidam twenty years ago. The heavenly-horse blade drops. Blood finds the mud that used to be a scoreboard.
blocks.ko: 유신은 차라리 지고 싶은 사람이 이기듯 이긴다 — 늦게, 흉하게, 이십 년 전 비담에게 가르친 가드를 뚫고. 천마 칼이 떨어진다. 피가, 한때 점수판이던 진흙을 찾는다.

blocks.html: Ninety-nine beads go into the mud after the blood, one at a time, like somebody counting.
blocks.ko: 아흔아홉 알이 피를 따라 진흙으로 떨어진다. 하나씩, 누가 세기라도 하듯.

en: …One hundred and nine.
Finally.

blocks.html: Bidam smiles with blood in his teeth — the same boy who once offered a headband across a desk.
blocks.ko: 비담은 피에 젖은 이로 웃는다 — 한때 책상 너머로 머리띠를 건네던 그 아이.

en: Hwarang Kim Yushin…

blocks.html: Yushin does not move to finish it, and there is nothing left to finish. For as long as the breath lasts the two of them look at each other the way they used to across the yard, back when the score was even and neither one wanted to go home.
blocks.ko: 유신은 끝을 내려 움직이지 않고, 끝낼 것도 남아 있지 않다. 숨이 붙어 있는 동안 둘은 서로를 본다 — 점수가 비겼고 둘 다 집에 가기 싫던 시절, 연무장 건너로 보던 그 눈으로.

blocks.html: Kangrim reads his name three times where the body has not yet finished falling — Bidam. Bidam. Bidam. — the ledger catching up to the last word.
blocks.ko: 강림은 몸이 아직 완전히 쓰러지기 전 그의 이름을 세 번 부른다 — 비담. 비담. 비담. — 마지막 말에 명부가 따라잡도록.

lines: 명부가 여기까지요. 함께 가십시다 — 폐하의 나라는 서라벌보다 회의록을 잘 남깁니다.
en: High Councillor.
Your list ends here. Walk with me — His Majesty’s kingdom keeps better minutes than Surabol.
One question, then we walk.
Were you a righteous traitor, or an unrighteous king?
…My father asked me that at a gate.
Write that I was his son.
Tell the sacred country I loved it badly.

blocks.html: The body finishes falling after the name does.
blocks.ko: 몸은 이름보다 늦게 쓰러진다.

blocks.html: Bisamun comes through the lines without a rider, at a walk, and stops over him. Nine beads swing under its jaw. When a Silla groom reaches for the bridle it lays its ears flat and shows him its teeth, and the groom, who has had a long ten days, steps back.
blocks.ko: 비사문이 주인 없이, 걸어서 대열을 지나와 그의 곁에 멈춰 선다. 턱 아래 아홉 알이 흔들린다. 신라 마부가 굴레에 손을 뻗자 말은 귀를 납작 젖히고 이를 드러내고, 열흘이 길었던 마부는 물러선다.

en: Leave it.
…Let it go. North.

blocks.html: Nobody asks him why north. The horse stands there until the body is taken, then turns and goes, past the Radiance wall and up the valley road, and afterwards the officers on the rampart cannot agree whether anyone opened the gate for it.
blocks.ko: 왜 북쪽이냐고 묻는 사람은 없다. 말은 시신이 옮겨질 때까지 서 있다가, 돌아서서 명활성 성벽을 지나 골짜기 길로 올라간다. 나중에 성벽 위의 장교들은 누가 그 말에게 문을 열어 주었는지를 두고 끝내 의견이 갈린다.

blocks.html: By then the Radiance wall is emptying. Black headbands go over the back of it and up the same valley road, and the palace blue goes up the slope after them.
blocks.ko: 그때쯤 명활성 성벽은 비어 가고 있다. 검은 머리띠들이 성 뒤로 넘어가 같은 골짜기 길로 달아나고, 궁의 푸른 띠가 비탈을 올라 그 뒤를 쫓는다.

blocks.speaker: A Hwarang
en: Marshal— the wall’s empty. They’re running up the valley.
Do we go after them?

blocks.html: Yushin kneels once, only to untie the black headband from the body. Then he stands, mud still wet, turns to the Hwarang behind him and names a house. Bidam’s own line. The one he carried in his jaw and never once claimed aloud.
blocks.ko: 유신은 한 번 무릎을 꿇는다. 시신에서 검은 머리띠를 풀기 위해서만. 그러고는 일어나, 진흙이 마르기도 전에 뒤따른 화랑들을 돌아보고 한 집안의 이름을 댄다. 비담의 핏줄. 비담이 턱 안에 물고 다니면서도 한 번도 입 밖에 내지 않은 그 핏줄.

en: Erase Bidam’s house.
The Son line, every one of them.
Treason’s blood must be cut.

lines: 비담은 죽었다. 열흘 동안 차를 따르고, 칼을 맞았다.
그의 대청까지 태우면 — 우리가 지키려던 육촌 중 하나를 스스로 지운다.
en: Yushin…
Bidam is dead. He poured tea for ten days, then took the blade.
If you burn his hall — we erase one of the Six Elders with our own hands.

blocks.html: Yushin leans close — close enough that the officers hear only breath, and Alchun hears the sentence.
blocks.ko: 유신이 몸을 기울인다 — 장교들에게는 숨소리만 들릴 만큼, 알천에게는 문장이 들릴 만큼.

en: Blood is inevitable…

blocks.html: Alchun goes pale. Down the line an officer asks for the order to be repeated. Nobody repeats it. Yushin mounts, and the order stands.
blocks.ko: 알천의 얼굴이 창백해진다. 대열 저쪽에서 한 장교가 명령을 다시 내려 달라 청한다. 아무도 되풀이하지 않는다. 유신이 말에 오르고, 명령은 선다.

blocks.html: Somewhere behind the palace wall, the queen is already slipping away.
blocks.ko: 궁 담장 너머 어딘가에서, 여왕은 이미 떠나가고 있다.

blocks.label: The Queen’s Bedside
blocks.ko: 여왕의 머리맡

blocks.html: Rain finds the lattice before the physicians do. It is a small rain. It beads on the marshal’s sleeve and on the queen’s mouth, and neither of them has a hand free for it.
blocks.ko: 의원보다 비가 먼저 창살에 닿는다. 작은 비다. 원수의 소매에, 여왕의 입술에 맺힌다. 둘 다 그 비를 닦을 손이 없다.

en: Your Majesty.
General.
The physicians are in the corridor.
I told them the rain can wait.

lines: 작은 비야. 나를 데려갈 비는 아니네.
en: Leave them.
It is a small rain. It will not be what takes me.
Your Majesty—
The year I took the crown. You remember.
You said you would serve me to the end.
“I will serve you to the end.”
Yes.
And here we are.
Did I not promise to stay to the last moment.
You did. General.

lines: 네가 연무장에서 셈을 놓치던 때, 나는 공주였어.
en: …Princess.
Say it the old way.
When you lost the count on the yard, I was a princess.
Hwarang. That is what I was.
A hwarang who lost one count.
You do not lose counts.
I lost one.
Which one, I will not say.
Then stop being a general about it.
Dukman.
…Don’t.
Since the vote I have been Majesty.
Say the name I had before the room.
Dukman.
Yushin.
I am here.
I know.
Stay.
I can do a little rain.

blocks.html: The rain keeps on, small, on the lattice and on his sleeve. Her hand stays in his until it does not. The escort waits until the marshal’s hands have finished their work.
blocks.ko: 비는 그대로다. 창살에, 그의 소매에, 작게. 그녀의 손은 그의 손 안에 있다가, 어느 순간 아니게 된다. 호위는 원수의 손이 일을 마칠 때까지 기다린다.

blocks.html: Kangrim reads her name three times — Dukman. Dukman. Dukman. — the ledger’s habit before a Sacred Bone line closes.
blocks.ko: 강림은 그녀의 이름을 세 번 부른다 — 덕만. 덕만. 덕만. — 성골의 혈통이 닫히기 전 명부의 버릇대로.
blocks.art: One panel: the ledger closing in Kangrim’s hands, rain on the lattice behind.

blocks.html: The ministers did not know where that was, and asked, “Where?” The queen said, “South of Mount Nang.” On that very month and day the queen did die, and the ministers buried her on the sunny slope of Mount Nang.
blocks.ko: 신하들이 그곳이 어디인지 몰라 “어디입니까?” 하고 아뢰니, 왕이 “낭산 남쪽이다.” 하였다. 그 달 그 날에 이르러 왕이 과연 세상을 떠나니, 신하들이 낭산 남쪽 기슭에 장사 지냈다.
blocks.hanja: 群臣罔知其處，奏云：「何所？」王曰：「狼山南也。」至其月日王果崩，群臣葬於狼山之陽。
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Wonders 1 — Queen Seondeok knows three things in advance (善德王知幾三事)

blocks.html: That night Yushin remembers the first morning on the yard, and it is not the way he has been telling it.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 유신은 연무장의 첫 아침을 기억한다. 그것은 그가 말해 온 방식이 아니다.

blocks.html: The same desk. The same headband held out across it, still wet at the knuckle end.
blocks.ko: 같은 책상. 그 너머로 내밀어진 같은 머리띠. 주먹 닿은 끝은 아직 젖어 있다.

lines: 내 이름은 김유신! 신라의 대장군이 될 거요!!
en: It’s all right. I will overcome it myself.
My name is Kim Yushin! I will be the great general of Silla!!
Oh — and your name, hyung?
My name? Bidam.
That kid…. he’ll be someone great.

blocks.label: The Empty Pavilion
blocks.ko: 빈 정자

blocks.html: That night Yushin walks out alone to the pavilion between the old camp lines. The low table is still there, and on it the cup he never touched. He lays the black headband beside it and sits down across from no one.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 유신은 혼자 옛 진영 사이의 정자로 걸어 나간다. 낮은 상은 그대로 있고, 그 위에 그가 끝내 손대지 않은 잔이 있다. 그는 그 옆에 검은 머리띠를 내려놓고, 아무도 없는 맞은편을 두고 앉는다.
blocks.art: Wide: the empty pavilion at night, Yushin small at the low table, the untouched cup in front of him.

en: You Gaya wretch…!
blocks.art: Echo balloon over Yushin at the table; Bidam is not in the panel.

blocks.html: The one hand that said no is gone. Now the crown has to fit Seungman, and it was made for someone else…!
blocks.ko: 반대하던 단 한 손은 사라졌다. 이제 승만이 그 왕관을 써야 한다. 다른 사람에게 맞춰 만든 왕관을…!

logline.en: The crown was made for her cousin and has to be padded at the temples.
logline.ko: 왕관은 사촌에게 맞춰 만든 것이라, 관자놀이에 솜을 대야 한다.

images.alt: Poster key art: newly crowned Queen Jinduk steps barefoot onto the washed yard and the white heavenly horse kneels before her through the censer smoke
images.prompt: HEEWON STYLE MOVIE POSTER key art, 2:1 letterbox, composed so nothing important touches the top or bottom edge; crowns, antlers, wings and heads stay well inside the central band; no title, no lettering. INTERACTION: the wingless white heavenly horse Chunma kneels on its forelegs on the wet flagstones; Queen Jinduk, in her new gold Silla crown and violet-and-white royal silk, steps forward and rests both hands on its bowed head, her face grave and tired, accepting it. Their reflections lie together in the wet stone. CHUNMA HAS NO WINGS: a wingless white heavenly horse, bare white back and shoulders, nothing feathered anywhere; it rides the air on curling cloud-and-flame streamers trailing from its legs. One pale violet dawn break (#9d7bd0) through the smoke catches her crown, her hands and the horse’s mane; the yard and the halls behind sink into slate and ink. Censer smoke as ink wash in the near foreground. STYLE: HEEWON STYLE, more painterly, with hints of Korean ink painting — Korean webtoon figures (clean ink linework, simplified expressive faces matching the attached portrait, watercolor-washed) inside a hand-painted world of watercolor and oil with traditional sumukhwa ink: splashed-ink storm clouds, bold dry calligraphic brush strokes in manes, fur, feathers, robes and grass, ink bleeding into wet wash, small ink splatters and drips near the frame edges, patches of bare rice paper where the edges dissolve; oil glazes only deepen the darks, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. Movie-poster key art: bold iconic silhouette, the two subjects large and close, one dramatic low angle, one bright break of light behind them, big dark masses, few hues plus one accent, film-poster drama but NO text, NO title, NO credits, NO logo, NO seal stamp. Not photoreal, not 3D. No glow aura, no halo, no emissive outline — the accent colour is real light. One of each named person. No watermark. CANON — QUEEN JINDUK — FACE and garments from attached /ch_jinduk.png (face only; invent a new pose). It has NO WINGS — no feathers, no bird wings, nothing growing from the shoulders. It rides the sky on curling cloud-and-flame streamers trailing from its legs and chest, as on the painted birch-bark flap. Divine render: numinous through scale and atmosphere, never a glow outline. Kneels and cries beside the purple egg at Najeong, sees men approach, neighs and rises into the sky. | PLACE Surabol (서라벌 (경주)) — attached board /pl_eastern_palace.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Seorabeol palace: Silla giwa halls, packed-earth yards, timber verandas. | HORSE ANATOMY is a centrepiece: the whole horse body reads clearly and beautifully — arched neck, deep chest, sloping shoulder, round haunch, clean long legs in a correct gait, every muscle modelled by the one hard key with a bright edge along the topline and deep shadow under the belly; the horse is never cropped into a blob, never hidden behind dust, never stiff like a toy; mane and tail as flowing painted strokes; the coat colour exactly as the board. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, shaded in soft watercolor washes and translucent oil glazes instead of flat cel fill — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, not 3D. THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS are a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST room (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt) painted in that same wash-and-glaze: a warm umber-to-black ground, walls, timber, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft with soft sfumato falloff — the webtoon figures are set INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. LIGHT is movie tenebrism: big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

blocks.html: The crown was made for her cousin and has to be padded at the temples. Seungman sits very still while the goldsmith does it, because somebody told her once that Dukman never fidgeted, and she has believed it for forty years.
blocks.ko: 왕관은 사촌 언니에게 맞춰 만든 것이라 관자놀이에 솜을 대야 한다. 금장이 그 일을 하는 동안 승만은 꼼짝 않고 앉아 있다. 덕만은 한 번도 몸을 비튼 적이 없다고 누가 말해 준 적이 있고, 그녀는 마흔 해 동안 그 말을 믿어 왔다.

blocks.html: Seungman is crowned Queen Jinduk before the blood on the yard dries. The bloodline’s last polite miracle, stamped and filed while the censers are still warm. The succession Bidam died objecting to passes at last. Unanimously.
blocks.ko: 마당의 피가 마르기도 전에 승만이 진덕여왕으로 즉위한다. 그 핏줄의 마지막 점잖은 기적, 향로가 식기도 전에 도장 찍혀 철해진다. 비담이 반대하다 죽은 계승이 마침내 통과된다. 만장일치로.

blocks.html: Taizong* of Tang sent an envoy bearing his tally to confer on the late queen the posthumous rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and to invest the new queen as Pillar of State and King of Lelang Commandery.
blocks.ko: 당 태종*이 사신에게 부절을 주어 보내, 앞 임금에게 광록대부를 추증하고, 이어 왕을 책봉하여 주국으로 삼고 낙랑군왕에 봉하였다.
blocks.hanja: 唐太宗遣使持節，追贈前王爲光祿大夫。仍冊命王爲柱國封樂浪郡王。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — Queen Jindeok, yr. 1 (647), 2nd month

notes.html: Taizong is the temple name Tang gave him after death. In this book he is the Second Emperor.
notes.ko: 태종은 죽은 뒤 받은 묘호다. 이 책에서는 ‘두 번째 황제’다.

blocks.hanja: 勝曼姿質豐麗，長七尺，垂手過膝。
blocks.html: Seungman was full-figured and beautiful, seven feet tall, and her hands hung down past her knees.
blocks.ko: 승만은 자태가 풍만하고 아름다웠으며, 키가 일곱 자에, 손을 내리면 무릎 아래까지 닿았다.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — Queen Jindeok, accession notice

blocks.html: Alchun is not at the coronation. The court writes his absence down as illness. Everyone knows the illness’s name. It lasted ten days.
blocks.ko: 알천은 즉위식에 없다. 궁은 그의 부재를 병으로 적는다. 모두가 그 병의 이름을 안다. 그 병은 열흘을 갔다.

blocks.html: The court does not mean to compare. It simply cannot stop. The old Queen read the peony seeds before they were planted. She heard frogs at Jade Gate Pond in midwinter and sent two thousand men to the exact valley where five hundred Baekje soldiers were hiding. She named the day of her own death and was right about it. The new Queen is gentle, and good at a loom, and has never once predicted anything.
blocks.ko: 조정은 견주려는 게 아니다. 그냥 멈출 수가 없다. 선왕은 모란씨를 심기도 전에 읽어 냈다. 한겨울 옥문지에서 개구리 우는 소리를 듣고 이천 군사를 꼭 그 골짜기로 보내 숨어 있던 백제군 오백을 잡았다. 제가 죽을 날을 짚었고, 그 날이 맞았다. 새 여왕은 온화하고, 베틀을 잘 다루고, 무엇 하나 예언한 적이 없다.

lines: 선왕마마셨으면 비 올 줄 아셨을 텐데.
en: The old Queen would have known it was going to rain.
Shh.
…She would have, though.

blocks.html: After the rites, the new queen keeps two men behind. One of them has not had time to wash the mud off his boots.
blocks.ko: 의식이 끝나자 새 여왕은 두 사람을 남긴다. 그중 하나는 아직 신발의 진흙을 씻을 틈도 없었다.

en: Yushin… preserve the sacred country…
Bidam…

blocks.html: She does not finish the name. Everyone in Surabol has heard what Bidam called him by the end. Gaya. Never of Silla.
blocks.ko: 그녀는 이름을 끝까지 부르지 못한다. 비담이 끝에 그를 뭐라 불렀는지 서라벌에서 모르는 사람이 없다. 가야 놈. 신라 사람이었던 적도 없는 놈.

lines: 유신… 설마 비담의 말이 마음에 걸리느냐…?
en: Yushin… surely Bidam’s words are not weighing on you…?
No — what could there be to weigh on me.
I am a loyal servant of the sacred country.

blocks.html: He says it the way he says the oath on the yard, every word where it belongs. His right hand has closed on his sword belt and does not open. She grew up beside Dukman. She notices hands.
blocks.ko: 그는 연무장에서 맹세를 외듯 말한다. 단어 하나하나가 제자리에 있다. 오른손은 칼띠를 쥔 채 펴지지 않는다. 그녀는 덕만 곁에서 자랐다. 손을 볼 줄 안다.

en: Then let go of the belt, General.
Nobody here is going to draw on you.
lines: 여기서 자네한테 칼 뽑을 사람은 없네.

blocks.html: He lets go. It takes him a moment to remember how.
blocks.ko: 그가 손을 놓는다. 어떻게 놓는지 떠올리는 데 잠깐이 걸린다.

lines: 언니는 개구리보다 먼저 개구리를 알았네. 나는 비 올 날도 모르는데.
en: Chunchu.
Unni knew about the frogs before the frogs did. I can’t even tell when it’s going to rain.

lines: 전하, 누구도 달더러 해가 되라 하지 않습니다.
사람들이 달을 사랑하는 건 똑바로 쳐다보게 해 주기 때문이지요.
en: Majesty, nobody asks the moon to be the sun.
They love it because it lets them look straight at it.
…You had that ready.
Since the funeral, Majesty.

blocks.html: Then the border spoils the moment, the way borders do. A runner comes in still wearing the road. Baekje is over the western line again, three forts at once. The court turns to the new queen the way it used to turn to the old one, waiting for her to already know.
blocks.ko: 그때 국경이 이 순간을 망친다. 국경은 늘 그렇다. 길을 그대로 뒤집어쓴 전령이 들어온다. 백제가 또 서쪽 경계를 넘었다. 성 셋을 한꺼번에. 조정은 예전에 선왕을 보던 눈으로 새 여왕을 본다. 그녀가 이미 알고 있기를 기다리며.

en: I don’t know.
Unni would have dreamed it last week. I didn’t dream anything. I slept badly, that’s all.
lines: 언니였으면 지난주에 꿈으로 봤겠지. 나는 아무 꿈도 안 꿨어. 잠을 설쳤을 뿐이야.

en: Give me the men, Majesty. I’ll go.
I won’t need a dream to find three forts.
lines: 성 셋 찾는 데 꿈은 필요 없습니다.

en: He’ll win them back. He always does.
And next spring they’ll come for three more. And the spring after that.
Majesty, we can hold the door forever. We can’t make it stop knocking.
lines: 그리고 내년 봄이면 또 셋을 노리겠지요. 그다음 봄에도.
전하, 문은 영원히 막을 수 있습니다. 두드리는 걸 멈추게 할 수는 없지만요.

en: Then what stops it?
A bigger door.
One man alive has an army that size. He lost a summer at Ansi, and he hates losing.
Let me go west and ask him.
lines: 그만한 군대를 가진 사람은 세상에 하나뿐입니다. 안시에서 여름 한 철을 잃었고, 지는 걸 싫어하지요.
서쪽으로 가서 청해 보게 해 주십시오.

blocks.html: The old queen would have decided this with a smile, as if she had read it in the stars the night before. The new one has read nothing. She looks at Yushin’s hand, which is back on the belt. She looks at Chunchu, who has clearly had this ready since the funeral too.
blocks.ko: 선왕이었다면 전날 밤 별에서 읽기라도 한 듯 웃으며 정했을 일이다. 새 여왕은 아무것도 읽지 않았다. 그녀는 다시 칼띠로 돌아간 유신의 손을 본다. 춘추를 본다. 이 말도 장례 때부터 준비해 둔 게 분명한 얼굴이다.

en: Yushin, take the men.
Chunchu, go west.
…If you’re both wrong, I want to hear it from you. Not from a runner.
lines: ……둘 다 틀리거든, 전령 말고 자네들한테서 듣고 싶네.

blocks.html: Outside, it starts to rain. Nobody predicted it.
blocks.ko: 밖에 비가 내리기 시작한다. 아무도 예언하지 않은 비다.

en: …It’s raining.
Did anybody know?
Shh.

blocks.html: Nobody says a word about the old queen. For the maids, that is the coronation.
blocks.ko: 선왕 이야기는 아무도 꺼내지 않는다. 시녀들에게는 그게 즉위식이다.

blocks.html: At night she sits at a loom, because her hands want work that nobody will compare. Three years from now she will weave an ode to the Tang emperor into a length of silk, and it will do more for Silla than any prophecy her cousin made. Nobody at court thinks to compare that.
blocks.ko: 밤이면 그녀는 베틀 앞에 앉는다. 누구도 견주지 않을 일을 손이 원해서다. 세 해 뒤 그녀는 당 황제에게 바치는 송시를 비단 한 필에 짜 넣을 것이고, 그것이 사촌 언니의 어떤 예언보다 신라에 더 큰 일을 해낼 것이다. 조정의 누구도 그것은 견주어 볼 생각을 하지 않는다.

blocks.html: Silla needs an army. Only one man alive can lend it, and he has never lent anything for free. Chunchu goes west…!
blocks.ko: 신라에는 군대가 필요하다. 그것을 빌려줄 사람은 세상에 단 하나, 공짜로는 아무것도 빌려준 적 없는 사람이다. 춘추가 서쪽으로 간다…!

logline.en: Everyone on earth wants something from the Son of Heaven. Most of them bring tribute. Chunchu brings an offer.
logline.ko: 땅 위의 모든 이가 천자에게 바라는 것이 있다. 대개는 공물을 들고 온다. 춘추는 제안을 들고 온다.

THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. LIGHT is movie tenebrism: big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — a lit figure against a background pushed two steps darker, or a near-black silhouette against the one bright break; foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

blocks.label: The Son of Heaven
blocks.ko: 천자

blocks.html: Everyone on earth wants something from the Son of Heaven. Most of them bring tribute. Chunchu brings an offer.
blocks.ko: 땅 위의 모든 이가 천자에게 바라는 것이 있다. 대개는 공물을 들고 온다. 춘추는 제안을 들고 온다.

blocks.hanja: 皇帝
blocks.html: Huang, the god-kings of the dawn of the world. Di, the lord of heaven. The first man to put the two words together burned the books. Every other ruler on earth is a king. This one is the Son of Heaven, and he would like it said in that order.
blocks.ko: 황(皇)은 세상이 처음 열릴 때의 신령한 임금들, 제(帝)는 하늘의 주인. 두 글자를 처음 붙여 쓴 사내는 책을 불살랐다. 땅 위의 다른 통치자는 모두 왕이다. 이 사람은 하늘의 아들이고, 그 순서대로 불리기를 원한다.

blocks.html: The embassy comes in at the hour the street drums stop. The great avenue opens ahead of it, a hundred and fifty paces wide and perfectly empty.
blocks.ko: 사절단은 거리의 북이 멎는 시각에 들어선다. 눈앞에 대로가 열린다. 폭이 백오십 보, 완벽하게 텅 비어 있다.

blocks.caption: Silla’s one harbour, one sea, and a road to Chang’an long enough to rehearse a speech forty times.
blocks.ko: 신라의 하나뿐인 항구, 바다 하나, 그리고 연설을 마흔 번은 연습할 만큼 긴 장안 길.

blocks.html: Chang’an is a hundred and eight walled wards, locked at the drums. At the lodging a ward chief is waiting with a lamp and a register. He does not look at the prince’s face. He counts heads the way a man counts sacks, and writes a number.
blocks.ko: 장안은 담장을 두른 방(坊) 백여덟 개로 되어 있고, 북이 울리면 모두 잠긴다. 객관 앞에서 방정(坊正)이 등불과 장부를 들고 기다린다. 그는 왕자의 얼굴을 보지 않는다. 자루를 세듯 머릿수를 세고, 숫자 하나를 적는다.

blocks.speaker: Ward chief
en: Silla embassy. Eleven mouths.
Eleven in, eleven out. If one of you dies, report it to the ward before the morning drum.
We’ll send a man to make up the count.
lines: 열하나 들어왔으면 열하나 나가는 거요. 누가 죽으면 새벽 북 전에 방에 신고하시오.
모자라는 머릿수는 우리가 사람 하나 보내서 맞춰 드리지.
zh: 十一口進，十一口出。若有人死，晨鼓前報坊。
zhLatn: Xīnluó shǐtuán. Shíyī kǒu.
Shíyī kǒu jìn, shíyī kǒu chū. Ruò yǒu rén sǐ, chén gǔ qián bào fāng.
Quē de shù, fāng lǐ pài rén bǔ shàng.

en: Make up the count.
…With whom?

blocks.speaker: Ward chief
en: With a man.
zhLatn: Yòng rén.

en: Any man?

blocks.speaker: Ward chief
en: The register hasn’t got a column for names, sir. Only for the number.
lines: 장부에는 이름 칸이 없소. 숫자 칸만 있지.
zh: 冊上沒有名字那一欄。只有數。
zhLatn: Cè shàng méiyǒu míngzi nà yì lán. Zhǐ yǒu shù.

blocks.caption: Chunchu’s second son. He reads Tang characters better than his father would like.
blocks.ko: 춘추의 둘째 아들. 당의 글자를 아버지가 바라는 것보다 잘 읽는다.

blocks.html: Inmun reads the register over the man’s shoulder. Eleven. He will live in this city for most of his life, and in every count it ever makes of him he will be one stroke in that column.
blocks.ko: 인문은 사내의 어깨 너머로 장부를 읽는다. 열하나. 그는 생의 대부분을 이 도시에서 살게 되고, 이 도시가 그를 셀 때마다 그는 저 칸의 획 하나일 것이다.

blocks.html: The tenth stroke is a young Hwarang called Jukji, who writes down everything. The eleventh is On Gunhae, who carries his master’s coat and has not said a word since the harbour. The ward chief does not look at him either.
blocks.ko: 열 번째 획은 무엇이든 받아 적는 젊은 화랑 죽지다. 열한 번째 획은 온군해다. 주인의 겉옷을 들고 다니며, 항구를 떠난 뒤로 한마디도 하지 않았다. 방정은 그도 쳐다보지 않는다.
